title: Languages Google publisher products support - Campaign Manager 360 Help

facts.fact: Google publisher products support publishers in several different languages, and a site's primary language is selected during the sign-up process.
facts.quote: Google publisher products support publishers in several different languages. You can select your site's primary language during the sign-up process.

facts.fact: If a publisher is approved, Google serves relevant ads to its pages in the appropriate language, even if the site contains multiple supported languages.
facts.quote: If you're approved, Google will serve relevant ads to your pages in the appropriate language, even if your site contains multiple supported languages.

facts.fact: Placing Google ad code on pages with content primarily in an unsupported language is not permitted under the Google Publisher Policies.
facts.quote: Placing Google ad code on pages with content primarily in an unsupported language is not permitted by the Google Publisher Policies.

facts.fact: The AdSense product interface and help center are not currently available in Estonian and Slovenian.
facts.quote: The AdSense product interface and help center are not currently available in this language.

facts.fact: The Ad Manager product interface and help center are not currently available in Bulgarian, among other listed languages.
facts.quote: The Ad Manager product interface and help center are not currently available in this language.

facts.fact: The AdMob product interface and help center are not currently available in Hindi, among other listed languages.
facts.quote: The AdMob product interface and help center are not currently available in this language.

facts.fact: English is listed among the languages currently allowed to be the primary language of a site or app.
